 In The High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
 Hon'ble Justice Sri Rakesh Thapliyal
 31st December, 2025
 Criminal Misc. Application (C528) No. 2335 of 2025
Surendra Singh .........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Another .........Respondents
Counsel for the Applicant: Mr. Saurabh Kumar Pandey,
 learned counsel.

entities.text:
High Court Of Uttarakhand
 At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the State: Mr. Deepak Bhardwaj,
 learned Brief Holder.

The present application has been preferred under Section 528 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, challenging the proceedings of Sessions Trial No. 01 of 2025, pending in the court of Special Judge (UPID Act, 2005), Nainital wherein the applicant is facing the trial for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 406, 120B IPC read with Section 3 of UPID Act.

2. It is argued by learned counsel for the applicant that at earlier point of time the applicant was the Director of the company, namely, J.K.V. Multi State Credit Cooperative Society Ltd., however, he has resigned in 2017 and, thereafter, the new list of the Director was published in the year 2021 wherein the name of the applicant is not shown as the Director of the company.

entities.text: J.K.V. Multi State Credit Cooperative Society Ltd.
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He further submits that the FIR has been lodged after five years of the resignation of the applicant and though he is not named in the FIR however, he has been charge sheeted.
He submits that the one another person namely Bagesh Mishra who resigned from the company in the year 2019 was also exonerated.

sentences.text: All these aspects required scrutiny but as per the list circulated in the year 2021 the applicant is not shown as the Director.
Steps to be taken within a week.
5. Let respondents may file counter affidavit within four weeks.

Two weeks thereafter is granted to the applicant to file rejoinder affidavit.
6.
In the meantime, the further proceedings of Session Trial No. 01 of 2025, pending in the court of Special Judge (UPID Act, 2005) Nainital, shall remain stayed qua the applicant only.

7. List this case in the month of March, 2026.
__________________

RAKESH THAPLIYAL, J.
